camel_example: aliyun ndr ListEntities --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy LastSeenTime --PageSize 10 --SortOrder desc --Page 1 --Lang zh --RecommendStatus 1 --EntityType.1 1 --ExcludeCountry false --EntityKey '192.0.2.10' --EntityUuid 'f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291' --CityId.1 330100 --RecommendAction observe --IsExternal true --CountryCode.1 CN --IncidentUuid 'f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291' --HideBlocked true --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries event-associated or global entities by paging and returns entity property, association statistics, and recommended action summary
description_zh: 分页查询事件关联实体或全局实体，返回实体属性、关联统计和推荐处置摘要
kebab_example: aliyun ndr list-entities --page 1 --page-size 10 --incident-uuid f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291 --entity-uuid f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291 --entity-key 192.0.2.10 --entity-type 1 --is-external true --hide-blocked true --recommend-status 1 --recommend-action observe --order-by LastSeenTime --sort-order desc --lang zh --country-code CN --exclude-country false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEntities

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security event. If this parameter is not specified, the global entity list is queried
parameters.help_zh: 安全事件 ID。不传时查询全局实体列表
parameters.name: incident_uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the entity, which can be obtained from ListEntities
parameters.help_zh: 实体 ID，可从 ListEntities 获取
parameters.name: entity_uuid

parameters.help_en: The business value of the entity, such as an IP address, a domain name, or a cloud instance ID. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 实体的业务值，例如 IP 地址、域名或云实例 ID，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: entity_key

parameters.help_en: The list of entity types. Valid values: 1: IP address. 2: Cloud instance. 3: Host account. 4: Domain name. 5: Back-to-origin aggregation node for cloud services. 6: File. If this parameter is not specified, type 5 is excluded by default
parameters.help_zh: 实体类型列表。1 表示 IP，2 表示云实例，3 表示主机账号，4 表示域名，5 表示云产品回源聚合节点，6 表示文件。不传时默认排除类型 5
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the entity is an external entity. A value of true indicates that only external entities are queried. A value of false indicates that only internal entities are queried. If this parameter is not specified, entities are not filtered by internal or external attributes
parameters.help_zh: 是否为外部实体。true 表示仅查询外部实体，false 表示仅查询内部实体；不传时不按内外部属性过滤
parameters.name: is_external

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to hide entities that have been blocked. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否隐藏已生效封禁的实体，默认 false
parameters.name: hide_blocked

parameters.help_en: Reserved parameter. This parameter is not used for query filtering. Do not specify this parameter. For the recommended action status, see Recommendation.Status
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数，当前不参与查询过滤，请勿设置。推荐处置状态请查看 Recommendation.Status
parameters.name: recommend_status

parameters.help_en: The filter for recommended actions. Valid values: block: Block. observe: Observe. allow: Allow. none: No recommended action
parameters.help_zh: 推荐处置动作筛选。block 表示封禁，observe 表示观察，allow 表示放行，none 表示无建议动作
parameters.name: recommend_action

parameters.help_en: The field used for sorting. Valid values: LastSeenTime: the time when the entity was last discovered. EntityKey: the entity value
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。LastSeenTime 表示最近发现时点，EntityKey 表示实体值
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: asc: ascending order. desc: descending order. The default value is desc for LastSeenTime and asc for EntityKey
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。asc 表示升序，desc 表示降序；LastSeenTime 默认 desc，EntityKey 默认 asc
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned content. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回内容的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文，默认中文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The country codes for multi-select matching. A maximum of 300 codes can be specified, such as CN and US
parameters.help_zh: 国家代码，多选匹配，最多300项，如CN、US
parameters.name: country_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to exclude the selected countries, regions, and cities. Default value: false. A value of true indicates that the selected countries, regions, and cities are excluded. A value of false indicates that they are included. Entities with unknown regions are retained in exclusion mode. If both CountryCode and CityId are empty, no filtering is performed
parameters.help_zh: 是否排除所选国家/地区和城市，默认 false。true 表示排除，false 表示包含；未知地域实体在排除模式下保留。CountryCode 和 CityId 均为空时不筛选
parameters.name: exclude_country

parameters.help_en: The list of city IDs in the Chinese mainland. A maximum of 1,000 IDs can be specified. Use six-digit city IDs, such as 330100 for Hangzhou. If this parameter and CountryCode are specified at the same time, entities that match any of the selected countries, regions, or cities are returned. Whether to exclude them is determined by ExcludeCountry
parameters.help_zh: 中国大陆城市 ID 列表，最多 1000 项。使用六位城市 ID，例如 330100 表示杭州。与 CountryCode 同时传入时匹配任一所选国家/地区或城市；是否排除由 ExcludeCountry 决定
parameters.name: city_id

Recommendation.description_en: The recommended action summary for the entity. The recommendation does not indicate that the action has been executed

The recommended action. Valid values:
block: Block.
observe: Observe.

Duration.description_en: The recommended blocking duration, in seconds. A value of -1 indicates permanent blocking. This parameter is valid only when blocking is recommended
Duration.description_zh: 建议封禁时长，单位为秒；-1 表示永久。仅在建议封禁时有意义

ReviewTime.description_en: The time of the last action review, in UNIX milliseconds
ReviewTime.description_zh: 最近一次处置研判时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Status.description_en:
The generation status of the recommended action result. Valid values:
processing: Generating for the first time.
updating: Updating.
completed: Completed.
failed: Failed to generate for the first time.
update_failed: Failed to update.
When the status is updating or update_failed, the previous valid recommendation result is retained
Status.description_zh: 推荐处置结果的生成状态。processing 表示首次生成中，updating 表示更新中，completed 表示完成，failed 表示首次生成失败，update_failed 表示更新失败。updating 和 update_failed 时可保留上一次有效推荐结果

Summary.example: 建议核对访问行为并持续观察。

RelateIncidentCount.description_en: The number of security events associated with the entity in the last 30 days, counted by the most recent occurrence time of the events. This is not limited to the number of events in the current incident
